Ticker desk · for your approval · 2026-10-16 · not shipped

Before → after: what you see before scrolling

Each pair is the first screen at real size, the part of the desk you see without scrolling. Before is the site as deployed now; after is the new build (production’s after reads the real production API). The pink numbers mark the same element in both, so compare 1 with 1, 2 with 2.

The one-line difference: before, the first screen spends its top third on a tab row and a five-line sample note, and the chart is cut off at its title. After, the price, its change and the dealer verdict come first, and the whole chart with every level fits on the first screen.

Staging desk · 1280 px

  • 1The price. Before: at y≈410, below the tabs and the sample note, with no change on the day. After: the first thing under the nav (y≈214), with ▼ −0.13 (−0.02%).
  • 2The verdict. Before: a small green “positive gamma” chip, so the meaning rides on the color. After: “+γ long gamma above 683.92”, neutral, with the sign and the level in words.
  • 3The chart’s title. Before: “Structure field”, the name of the chart. After: what it shows: dealers are long gamma, spot 1.0% above the 683.92 flip.
  • 4The levels. New: a one-line reading of the levels (“the flip is 1.0% below; the walls sit 1.9% above and 5.6% below”), and the whole ladder is now on the first screen.
  • 5The tabs. Before: a full row above everything. After: in the masthead’s right column, where they take no height.
  • 6The sample note. Before: five lines of sample detail above the price. After: moved under the desk as “About this sample”; the “Demo · sample data” tags still mark every figure.

Production desk · 1280 px

The production desk’s top is unchanged (it has no price of its own: the chart is TradingView’s). The change is beside and below the chart.

  • ABeside the chart. Before: an Off card (FINRA short-sale volume) took the slot next to the chart, and the real SEC filings sat below the fold. After: the SEC panels that have live data (Recent filings, Insider trades) sit beside the chart.
  • BFINRA. Before: two separate Off cards. After: one Off card for both FINRA datasets, after the live panels, with one reason.

Phone · staging · 390 px
